title: EFC — How Energy Flow Sustains Spacetime
abstract: Explains how continuous energy flow maintains the structural, geometric, and dynamical properties of spacetime within the EFC framework. Outlines how entropy gradients, resistance fields, and distributed flows provide the underlying support for spacetime stability and large-scale structure.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Spacetime sustained by continuous energy flow

Geometric properties emerge from entropy-flow equilibrium
